name: postman-newman-api-testing
description: Portfolio API testing project using Postman, Newman, and GitHub Actions

scripts.validate:exports: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['postman/collections/QA Practice API.postman_collection.json','postman/environments/JSONPlaceholder QA.postman_environment.json']) { JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')); console.log('Valid JSON:', f); }"
scripts.test: npm run validate:exports && newman run "postman/collections/QA Practice API.postman_collection.json" -e "postman/environments/JSONPlaceholder QA.postman_environment.json"
scripts.test:ci: npm run validate:exports && mkdir -p reports && newman run "postman/collections/QA Practice API.postman_collection.json" -e "postman/environments/JSONPlaceholder QA.postman_environment.json" --reporters cli,junit --reporter-junit-export reports/newman-junit.xml
